body.name: rough-nuisance frontier handle
body.construction: At each outcome wavelet scale, combine the exact known-design weighted Galerkin identity with a finite-order degenerate correction whose high-rank covariance is controlled in the negative-order Besov aggregation norm; optimize the scale-dependent covariate ranks jointly with the outcome cutoff; match every active upper regime by a shared-propensity mixture or multiscale packing generated from def:lower-bound-handle.
